content: Per-digit template matching with cv2.matchTemplate is the established approach for fixed-font digit reading (PyImageSearch credit-card OCR, 7-segment digit recognition). Deterministic game UI fonts render pixel-identical glyphs; project's own identidade.py measured 1.000 same / 0.454 other correlation with masked tight crops. OCR engines underperform on unknown small fonts. Template-per-digit (10-12 templates incl. separator) beats OCR for closed glyph sets.
